units: device px, origin top-left, y down; divide by pixelRatio for CSS

shadow.note: Bodies are cropped to the measured shadow contour: the composited alpha above alphaThreshold, plus cropMarginDevicePx, with the outer taperDevicePx of the margin faded to zero on shadow-only pixels. sceneEdgeClips lists the sides where the shadow is cut by the scene frame itself, which is allowed.

rig.convention: azimuth 0 front (-Y), 90 +X, 180 behind, 270 -X; elevation above horizontal; roll about the light's aim axis in degrees

decals.note: faceMatrix maps the decal image's full pixel rect (top-left origin, y down) onto decalQuad.

layouts.method: each body sprite's tile alpha pasted at its manifest rect against one frame rendered with all of that layout's tiles present; a one-pixel dilation absorbs anti-aliasing, so any shifted pixel is a real misalignment
